question: Should the public channel-turn record.sessionKey option become the supported Plugin SDK contract for native commands that dispatch in one session while recording metadata in another?
rationale: The change is a compatibility-sensitive Plugin SDK surface addition spanning bundled channel implementations; source context establishes the intended behavior but not an explicit owner decision on the permanent API shape.

options.title: Approve the narrow SDK option
options.body: Accept record.sessionKey as the documented cross-channel contract, keeping the focused core test and provider wrapper coverage.

options.title: Keep the distinction provider-local
options.body: Avoid expanding the shared SDK if the target-session bookkeeping can be expressed through an existing provider-owned or command-context contract.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow SDK option
recommendation.body: Accept record.sessionKey as the documented cross-channel contract, keeping the focused core test and provider wrapper coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: Best available history signal: this contributor authored both the related merged lifecycle and the proposed extension, and can explain the intended invariant to the responsible owner.
